demo.title: Tappida Paatha — demo
demo.subtitle: A fictional Grade 3 class. Attendance comes from a simulated SATS feed. The parent phone is simulated, but the messages on it are the real ones a family is sent. The AI calls are real.
demo.signingIn: Signing in as the demo teacher…

guide.title: Try the loop in 3 minutes
guide.today: Teacher phone, Today: the simulated SATS register came in at 9:00 and shows Manjunath (roll 15, Kannada) absent.
guide.lesson: Tap Use the sample voice note (Nalikali Maths Part 1, p 4: more, less, equal), or record your own in Kannada, and confirm the lesson.
guide.evening: Tonight's message goes at 6 pm in a real school. Here tap Send messages now: it arrives on Manjunath's family's phone, in Kannada. Open it and pick a reason.
guide.approve: Approve: make the week's catch-up for Manjunath (2 days missed). Listen, read the summary, tick and tap Approve and send now: it goes to the family's phone at once.
guide.parent: Manjunath's family's phone: open the catch-up, listen, do the activity and tap a picture.
guide.after: Teacher phone: Missed lessons shows how Manjunath did; Week shows return speed and reasons.
guide.calendar: The story follows the real calendar: Manjunath was away the two school days before today and is away today. SATS and WhatsApp delivery are simulated; the AI calls are real.

children.title: Children and phone numbers
children.intro: WhatsApp goes only to the numbers saved here. Each family can have two, Number 1 and Number 2 (e.g. both parents, or a guardian), and every message goes to each one saved. Without either, the family gets nothing on WhatsApp. Saved numbers and home languages stay after a demo Reset; a home language changed here is used for everything made after it.
